captureLimitation: The first failing command was observed during execution, but the tee capture file remained empty. No unobserved error text is reconstructed or invented.
rootCause: The negative fixture used only ASCII bytes, for which the prior text-hash path and exact byte-hash path happened to produce the same digest. The negative control therefore could not distinguish the defect.
adjudication: The fixture was changed to include non-text binary bytes. The product code had already been corrected to sha256BytesDigest. The current-byte runtime now proves the text digest is not substituted for the exact byte digest.
